filing_office: Virginia State Corporation Commission, Clerk's Office
registered_agent_rules: Maintain a qualifying Virginia resident or authorized business agent and a Virginia registered office. An individual agent must meet the SCC's eligibility rules, such as being a member, manager or Virginia attorney.
annual_report_name: Annual registration fee payment; LLCs do not file an annual report
annual_report_due: Last day of the formation anniversary month, beginning in the year after formation.
plain_english_summary: Formation costs 100. Pay an annual registration fee of 50 to maintain the LLC.
common_mistake: Having no LLC annual report does not remove the annual registration fee.
notes: Ordinary domestic LLC. Annual-report fields represent the annual registration fee payment, not a report. Filing URLs are official gateways. Name-search URL, processing time, expedited service, franchise or privilege tax, publication requirement and operating-agreement mandate were not confirmed.
